functions.note: A pull-up to 1.8 V on the tile (R1/R2) selects address 0x6B; tie to GND for 0x6A. Never drive above 2.1 V (VDD + 0.3 V absolute maximum).

power.notes: MAX86174A core supply, 1.7-2.0 V (2.2 V absolute maximum): a 1.8 V rail, not 3.3 V. About 0.1-0.5 mA while sampling, 1 µA in shutdown.

LED supply (anodes of all four LEDs), 2.7-5.5 V; 5 V recommended so green LEDs keep driver headroom. Draws short LED pulses (up to 100 mA, the LEDs' pulse rating); average is well under 1 mA at typical frame rates. VLED must not come up before V+ (datasheet: "Power up VDD before VLED").

headline: heart rate, pulse oximetry, and hydration
description: The fully-integrated Sense.HR optical heart-rate and SpO₂ sensor combines the advanced Analog Devices MAX86174A photoplethysmography (PPG) front end with dual Vishay VEMD1060X01 silicon PIN photodiodes and four LEDs (two green, one red, one IR) for multi-wavelength reflective optical sensing.  The 20-bit ADC with a 256-word FIFO provides data at configurable rates from 1 to 2048 frames per second for external processing.
